short_description: Holy Shoot is a fast-paced roguelite action FPS set in a satirical version of Hell, packed with chaos, blessed heroes, and demonic bosses. Pick your hero, dive into hell, upgrade your build, and shoot your way through sin.
steam_categories: Single-player; Full controller support; DualShock Controller Support; DualSense Controller Support; Steam Cloud; Family Sharing
